summary.text: Jed Davis, a Republican, represents the 75th District in the Illinois House of Representatives, a seat Davis has held since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, Davis was born and raised in Lisbon, Illinois, and received a B.S. in civil engineering from Valparaiso University.
The biography lists Davis as a past chair of the Newark Zoning and Planning Commission, a past trustee of the Village of Newark, and school board president of Parkview Christian Academy.
